channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Israel Iran war: US and Israel Launch Operation Epic Fury strikes on Iran after Nuclear Talks Collapse, Sparking Retaliation
item.description: Coordinated US–Israeli strikes on Iran mark the most direct escalation in decades of nuclear tensions and failed diplomacy.

item.title: Maharashtra: Stray Dog Kills 7-Year-Old In Kalyan; Friend Injured, Corporators Demand KDMC Action
item.description: Khushil Shankar Waghe, a seven-year-old daily-wage labourer's son from Kalyan, Maharashtra was killed in a stray dog attack while his brave friend Nilesh, who rushed to save him, was seriously injured.

item.title: Iranian Defence Minister Amir Nasirzadeh Killed in Israeli Attack: Reports
item.description: Following the reported deaths of senior military leaders in coordinated airstrikes, Iran has launched retaliatory missile attacks across the Middle East, pushing the region toward a full-scale international conflict.

item.title: Explosions Reported in Saudi Capital Riyadh, Dubai and Abu Dhabi As Iran Launches Missiles
item.description: Following a joint U.S.-Israeli strike on its territory, Iran launched a multi-front ballistic missile retaliation against Gulf nations, claiming one life in the UAE and forcing a total shutdown of regional aviation.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei Killed, Says Trump; Iran Announces 40-Day Mourning
item.description: Iran enters 40 days of mourning as retaliatory strikes, regional airspace closures, and a leadership vacuum deepen geopolitical uncertainty across West Asia.

item.title: Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei Killed In Joint US-Israel Strikes: Claims Reports
item.description: Iran confirms 86-year-old Supreme Leader’s death after US-Israel strikes, prompting mourning, succession and fears of broader conflict.

item.title: Khamenei Killed at 86: 201 Dead as Iran Launches Missile Strikes on US-Israel Targets
item.description: A joint US-Israel strike that killed Iran’s Supreme Leader has triggered missile retaliation, civilian casualties, leadership uncertainty, and fears of a wider regional war.

item.title: No More Refund Nightmares: DGCA’s 48-Hour Free Cancellation Window Rebuilds Trust in Indian Skies
item.description: DGCA introduces 48-hour no-penalty cancellation for direct bookings, boosting passenger rights and trust in Indian aviation from March 26.

item.title: Maharashtra, Nagpur: Factory Blast Kills Over 18; Charred Bodies Identified Through DNA Tests, Probe Ordered
item.description: Over 18 dead, 24 injured as SBL Energy's detonator packing unit in Nagpur's Raulgaon explodes; bodies charred beyond recognition, DNA tests ordered, investigation underway.

item.title: Khamenei Killed in US-Israel Strikes; UK, France, Germany back US as Iran Vows Fierce Retaliation
item.description: After US-Israeli strikes reportedly killed Iran’s Supreme Leader Khamenei, Britain, France and Germany backed US, as Tehran vowed retaliation.
